MrBeast.text: His breakthrough viral video showed him counting to 100,000, which took him 40 hours.
MrBeast.evidence: On January 9, 2017, Donaldson published an almost day-long video of himself counting to 100,000, which became his breakthrough viral video. The ordeal took him 40 hours, with some parts sped up to "keep it under 24 hours".

T-Series.text: Founder Gulshan Kumar was a Delhi fruit juice seller who started out selling pirated Hindi songs.
T-Series.evidence: Kumar, initially a fruit juice seller in Delhi, founded T-Series to sell pirated Hindi songs before the company eventually began producing new music.

Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes.text: PewDiePie made a 2021 diss track about it called "Coco", which YouTube took down.
Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes.evidence: Following predictions that Cocomelon would soon surpass PewDiePie in subscribers, PewDiePie released a diss track titled "Coco" in February 2021. YouTube removed the video for violating its harassment and child safety policies; the audio remains on Spotify.

SET India.text: Until 2003 this Hindi channel also aired all Disney Channel shows and Disney movies.
SET India.evidence: Sony Entertainment Television (SET) is an Indian Hindi-language general entertainment pay television channel ... It also started airing all Disney Channel shows and Disney movies until 2003.

Vlad and Niki.text: In 2019 the brothers were judged the YouTubers making the most per video, about US$312,000 each.
Vlad and Niki.evidence: In 2019, the brothers were judged to be the YouTubers making the most money per video at an estimated US$312,000 per video.

Stokes Twins.text: After a warning over a fake bank robbery prank, they staged it again hours later on a college campus.
Stokes Twins.evidence: In October 2019, the twins filmed a prank in Irvine, California that onlookers mistook for a bank robbery. ... The brothers were issued a warning and released but repeated their behavior hours later on the University of California, Irvine campus prompting additional emergency response calls.

Kids Diana Show.text: Her spinoff series has her and her brother protecting their friends from villains who stand for boredom.
Kids Diana Show.evidence: Love, Diana is a live-action animated series consisting of short stories set in the fictional "Land of Play" that follows Diana and Roma as they protect friends and family from characters symbolizing demonized boredom.

김프로KIMPRO.text: It posted its first video in 2022 and by 2025 had overtaken Blackpink as South Korea's most-subscribed channel.
김프로KIMPRO.evidence: KIMPRO started its channel on 11 November 2017; the channel's first video was uploaded in August 2022. ... On 18 April 2025, KIMPRO became the first South Korean YouTube channel to reach 100 million subscribers, surpassing Blackpink to become the most-subscribed channel in South Korea.

Like Nastya.text: Her parents sold a bridal salon and a construction company in Russia, then started the channel.
Like Nastya.evidence: Before starting their channel, Anastasia's mother Anna owned a bridal salon in Krasnodar while her father Sergey owned a construction company. In 2015, Radzinskaya's parents sold their companies, and in January 2016, they created their YouTube channel, which grew rapidly from their content.

Alejo Igoa.text: In 2026 his live show sold out Buenos Aires's Movistar Arena seven times, for over 70,000 people.
Alejo Igoa.evidence: In April 2026, Igoa performed El Show de Alejo Igoa at the Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires, where more than 70,000 people attended seven sold-out performances.
